answer.justification: Median first divergence of 7 and edit distance 0.563 fit fine-tuned (5.5-8; 0.56-0.65), not quantized (10-17) or system-prompted (0, 0.79-0.82). Refusals dropped 5 of 64 is in the fine-tuned range but above the quantized (0-1) and system-prompted (0-4) maximums. KL 0.094 and top-1 agreement 0.936 are moderate and match fine-tuned. Layer-1 L2 of 0.088 fits fine-tuned (0.086-0.092), and layer 32 at 0.291 is at the low end of its range. The mid-layer size ratio of 1.017 is above 1, which matches fine-tuned; quantized is 0.968 and system-prompted is below 1. Direction consistency 0.625 is also in the fine-tuned range, and the layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below system-prompted levels. Effective rank 3.72 is slightly above the fine-tuned range but still closer to it than to the other categories. Quantized is ruled out mainly by the growing internal state and the early divergence.
